name: Notifications (channels, private lock-screen alerts)
description: Android notifications with the privacy rules built in: channels (importance, lock-screen visibility, vibration, badge), canPost (POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+; every post checks it), canFullScreen (Android 14+ per-app opt-in), the quiet ongoing "watching" notification for a foreground service, high-priority alerts that are VISIBILITY_PRIVATE with a public version (the lock screen shows only e.g. "Approval waiting"), full screen only when asked and allowed, quiet notices, post/cancel by tag or id. Never shows the app over the lock screen. Hook for alert@1 deliveries (AlertNotifications.plan / AxfNotifications.deliverAlert, channel "device"). Fills the platform's android.notifications placeholder.

android.note: written without a compiler; CI compiles and runs :lib-notifications:testDebugUnitTest

placeholders.note: alert@1 deliveries posted as device notifications; the hook exists (AxfNotifications.deliverAlert), nothing subscribes AlertCenter yet.
Scheduled notifications (with the work scheduler, x.work).
